title: Isometric lines carry Lebesgue measure to H¹, and ω₁ = 2
statement: (i) ω₁ := unitBallVolume 1, the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝ¹ (Euclid 1), equals 2. (ii) Let P ∈ ℕ and p, v ∈ ℝ^P with ‖v‖ = 1, and put γ(t) := p + t·v for t ∈ ℝ. Then γ is a measurable embedding ℝ → ℝ^P, and for every set I ⊆ ℝ the restriction of H¹ = μHE[1] (on ℝ^P) to γ(I) equals the push-forward γ_#(ℒ¹⌞I) of Lebesgue measure restricted to I, and H¹(γ(I)) = ℒ¹(I).
lean_statement: unitBallVolume 1 = 2 ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (p v : Euclid P), ‖v‖ = 1 → MeasurableEmbedding (fun t : ℝ => p + t • v) ∧ ∀ I : Set ℝ, (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict ((fun t : ℝ => p + t • v) '' I) = Measure.map (fun t : ℝ => p + t • v) (volume.restrict I) ∧ (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) ((fun t : ℝ => p + t • v) '' I) = volume I
